messages:
Sanjay: seeing a spike of 429s from dedicated pool hpc-reserved-eu-west1 since ~10:02 UTC. Queue length jumped, latency for small gen jobs went from 90ms -> 1.2s. Customers A/B reporting errors.
Maria: oncall looking. any recent deploys to the runtime?
deploy-bot: No deploys to cluster hpc-reserved-eu-west1 in the last 6h.
Olivia: checking autoscaler, last scale event was +1 node at 09:50 then nothing. Could be admission control kicking in.
Sanjay: admission logs: "admit_fail: pool_capacity_exceeded" for many request ids. sample: `req=0x8f3b client=customer-a model=gpt-lite seq=256`
Lee: past incidents this looked like token-imbalance from long-seq jobs filling GPU KV caches -> prevents new short jobs from being packed. Any large ongoing jobs?
Maria: stack query: `select count(*) from running_jobs where pool='hpc-reserved-eu-west1' and seq>1024;` => 6 jobs. Normally 0-1.
Olivia: customers A and C launched batch inference at ~09:58 via spike API, seq=2048. That explains KV hogging.
Sanjay: capacity-bot reports: "fairshare_active=true, pool_util=0.92, pending_queue=183, admitted_rate_drop=45%"
capacity-bot: Autoscaler blocked at max_reserved_nodes=8 for this pool. Current nodes=8.
Maria: can we bump reserved_nodes to 10 temporarily? What's the cost/impact?
Olivia: we can hot-add 2 nodes from spare global pool, but need approval. It will consume reserved quota for other customers and increase cost but will reduce admission rejects.
Lee: alternative: enable short-job preemption policy to evict >1k-seq jobs for 120s slices so short requests can be admitted. Risk: quality regression for batch jobs.
Sanjay: customer-A SLA says no preemption without notice. They run critical scoring. I'd prefer scale if possible.
Olivia: proposing emergency actions: 1) hot-add 2 nodes to hpc-reserved-eu-west1, 2) enable temporary burst-policy to allow short jobs to bypass fairshare for 10m, 3) notify affected customers.
Maria: I'm going to request quota transfer from capacity team and notify CS. @Olivia can you run the scale command?
Olivia: running scale now: ```sh
infra-cli pool scale --pool hpc-reserved-eu-west1 --nodes 10 --reason "emergency burst for KV-hogging batch jobs"```
deploy-bot: Scale request accepted, provisioning 2 nodes (expected ready in ~4m).
Sanjay: also seeing increased network egress to model cache S3, might be cold-starts for new nodes. watching errors.
Lee: to reduce future recurrence: (a) enforce per-job seq caps for reserved pools, (b) add automatic short-job bypass queue, (c) detect long-sequence batches and route them to dedicated batch tier.
Maria: CS alerted customers A/C with status note: "we've observed throttling; adding capacity now; mitigation in progress" :email: sent to account owners.
Olivia: nodes are up. capacity-bot: pool_util=0.62 pending_queue=12 admitted_rate=+120%
Sanjay: 429s dropping, latency returning to baseline. Monitoring for 30m.
Maria: action items logged: 1) follow-up retro to add seq-based admission policy (owner: Lee), 2) autoscaler to allow emergency+2 burst override (owner: Olivia), 3) notify product about suggestion for explicit batch tier for high-seq workloads (owner: Sanjay).
Lee: I'll open infra task and include perf test to validate fairness.
Sanjay: thanks all. marking incident as mitigated but keep channel open for 1h. :thumbsup:
